last_review.summary: The change is confined to the allowed middleware and meets the task requirements. It excludes query strings, decodes percent-encoded path content before redacting API-key and compact-JWT shapes, fails closed on malformed URLs, preserves safe metadata, remains stateless, and introduces no dependencies or architecture violations. Deterministic TypeScript build and Prisma validation passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
